title: Bratwurst und Kartoffeln
description: A traditional German dish featuring bratwurst sausage and boiled potatoes. This hearty meal is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add the potatoes and cook until they are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, grill the Bratwurst sausage until browned and cooked through.
Once the potatoes are done, drain them and serve alongside the Bratwurst and a side of mixed rice.
